Aspera Connect — phone install (simple)
=======================================

BEST — Google Play Internal testing (live)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
On the PHONE (Google account must be on the tester list):

  https://play.google.com/apps/internaltest/4701460117553190758

1. Open link → Accept / Become a tester
2. Install Aspera Connect from Play Store
3. Open app → Start for calls → Scan PC QR

No USB. No Developer Options. No Play Protect fight.
Version: 0.3.11

Allow-listed emails:
  marketing@thegstco.com

If "not available": that Gmail is not on the list — ask IT to add it.
